errata.error: RWS lists the Ameland Westgat gauge twice, as `ameland.westgat` and `amelandwestgat`, a few meters apart.
errata.response: Both are kept as served, and linked in `same_as` as one gauge.
errata.evidence: RWS's catalog lists both codes at 53.4916° N, 5.9412° E.
errata.report: Submitted through Rijkswaterstaat's web contact form on 2026-11-08. It asks whether the two codes are two sensors or a duplicate, since their levels differ by about 33 cm. No answer yet. Text in [#62](https://github.com/openwatersio/stillwell/issues/62).

errata.error: RWS's Kralendijk Plazabeach Terminal levels from 27 October 2026 on sit about 0.75 m above January and February 2026's, with no change of datum marked.
errata.response: The record splits into datum epochs on 27 October 2026, and the store keeps the values as served. No gauge nearby measures the offset, so the epoch before has none and stays out of the combined series, readable on its own zero, until RWS answers.
errata.evidence: Found by running GESLA's datum-jump rule (`datumJumps` in `src/sources/gesla`) over every record the store lists as coastal, November 2026; the store holds no other record of the gauge or gauge nearby to compare, so this rests on the record's own medians. Monthly medians are −0.62 m in January and February 2026 and +0.12 to +0.15 m in October and November, with no values between. No other gauge in the store lies within 150 km.
